The NBA’s new anti-tanking rule makes the Spurs’ young core even more special.

No more top-5 picks in three straight years for one team.

Which means what San Antonio just pulled off? Might never happen again.

1️⃣ 2023 - Victor Wembanyama, No. 1 pick.
4️⃣ 2024 - Stephon Castle, No. 4 pick.
2️⃣ 2025 - Dylan Harper, No. 2 pick.

That’s a generational draft sequence.

Three straight years.
Three elite prospects.
Three potential franchise-changing players.

And now? That window is officially closed under the new rules.

Which makes this Spurs rebuild feel even more historic.

We may never see an ethical rebuild like this again.

Because years from now, people might look back at this stretch the same way they talk about legendary draft runs in NBA history.
